big: Defence is not only for state-owned firms. Private companies build warships, artillery, ammunition and electronics too. Each has a different niche.

lines: L&T: warships, artillery and systems integration. Bharat Forge: artillery such as ATAGS and armoured vehicles. Solar Industries: explosives, ammunition and loitering munitions. Data Patterns and Astra Microwave: defence electronics and RF and microwave subsystems. Zen Technologies: simulators and anti-drone. Paras Defence: optics and drones.

intro: Figures as given in the lesson; confirm the latest before quoting.
note: Education only. Not a list of stocks to buy.
